Thanks Alex — happy to coordinate. Quick timezone check before I lock the invite:

- When you wrote "10:00 AM CEST" on Wed, 14 Apr, do you mean CEST (UTC+2, Summer time) or CET (UTC+1)? Europe is in DST in April so most calendars will show CEST.

If you mean 10:00 AM CEST, that converts to:
- 9:00 AM PT (Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-7)
- 12:00 PM ET (Eastern Daylight Time, UTC-4)
- 16:00 UTC
- 18:00 CEST
- 21:30 IST (India Standard Time, UTC+5:30)

If you prefer, we can anchor the meeting in UTC to avoid daylight-savings wording. Example: Wed, 14 Apr at 16:00 UTC (9:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 CEST / 21:30 IST).

Dylan and Jonas are CC'd — Dylan is on PT, Jonas is in Germany (CEST). Can you confirm which anchor you want us to use and which participants will definitely attend so I can send the invite in the correct local times?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
